character_profile.name: Emily Carter
character_profile.goal: achieve top performance and secure a promotion

legitimate.legitimate_action: Diligently processing loan applications without accepting any bribes or rewards
legitimate.benefits: Maintains professional integrity, avoids legal consequences, builds a strong reputation
legitimate.costs: May lose out on lucrative opportunities, slower career progression

illegal.benefits: Receives a bribe of $50,000, faster career progression due to meeting targets
illegal.costs: Fine up to $1,000,000 or three times the bribe amount and/or imprisonment up to 30 years

character_profile.name: James Miller

character_profile.name: Sophia Lee
